{{Quote|If you want juicy conversation and a hot cup of ardees, come to Dexter's Diner. If you want a ''good'' cup of ardees, try Biscuit Baron.|[[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]]|<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />}}
'''Dex's Diner''', originally '''Didi and Astri's Café''' or just '''Didi's Café''', was a diner located in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was run by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].

==History==
{{Quote|The best eats in the CoCo Town streets|Dexter's Diner advertisement on [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="HNN ad">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/194_2.gif|text=The Best Eats in the Coco Town Streets}}</ref>}}
[[File:DexsDiner-GerFFIndex.png|thumb|left|300px|The seating area of Dex's Diner's]]
Located in a lower-income [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] neighborhood near the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], the grease-speckled restaurant attracted a steady clientele of itinerant freighter pilots and dockworkers, as well as oddball assortment of regulars. Many workers from the manufacturing area came for some [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]], [[Ardees/Legends|ardees]] (also called "Jawa juice"), or the popular [[slider]]s. Also served was fried [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]], [[protato wedge]]s, and pickled [[gartro]] eggs. The food was oily and unhealthy, but also cheap and filling (and was misleadingly advertised as "the best eats in the CoCo Town streets"). It was rumored that Jettster salted his food with addictive drugs to create a craving that customers would return to satisfy.

[[Didi Oddo]] and his adopted daughter, [[Astri Oddo|Astri]], owned the diner before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]]. They had the diner retrofitted with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] for easy getaway, made by Astri Oddo to get away from her very frequent "accidents." After Astri Oddo married [[Bog Divinian]], they sold the diner to [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] and moved to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Jettster had it remodeled in the [[Med'soto style]] that was common during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]].

[[File:DexsDiner-FFFb.png|thumb|right|300px|The bar and kitchen of the diner]]
During Oddo's ownership, the diner was a frequent haunt of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Oddo's knowledge gleaned from customers and backroom dealings was an invaluable resource to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], albeit an unconventional one. Jettster continued Oddo's legacy and became a good friend of Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. On one occasion, Kenobi visited the diner to ask about the origin of a [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] used to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] associate [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Jettster was able to direct the Jedi to the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], where Kenobi discovered a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|secret clone army]] in development for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. During the ensuing [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jettster ventured to planet [[Dractu]] and harvested native [[Dractuvian cave slug]]s, which he served to Kenobi on Coruscant; the Jedi remarked that it was the best of the planet's disgusting cuisine.<ref name="Appetite for Adventure">{{CWACite|9|Appetite for Adventure}}</ref>

[[Renzii]] was a waiter who worked for Oddo, while the droid waitress [[FLO/Legends|FLO]], [[R4-A22/Legends|R4-A22]], and Human waitress [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]] were employed by Jettster at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

With the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Jettster became one of the [[Erased]], eliminating records of his existence so as to not be prosecuted by the Empire for [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. The diner was destroyed when he went underground, but was later repaired, as Bagwa ran it throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Dex's Diner is the level hub of ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'', containing gateways to each level and a shop for unlockable content. However, it is referred to as Dexter's Diner.
